title: Ego-Graph Runtime State
description: Schema for the in-memory ego-graph state managed by the ego-graph.js module. This state is never persisted — it exists only during a browser session.

mode.description: Current view mode. 'ego' = spotlight active with neighborhood filtering. 'full' = all nodes visible.

spotlightId.description: Node ID of the current ego-graph center. Null when in full mode.
